from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one document from the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being parsed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers within the provided collection that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
